title: Uber rival inDrive eyes 2027 robotaxi tests in Central Asia with Pony.ai and Nvidia
script:
Ride hailing platform inDrive plans to test robotaxis in Central Asia.
The company is partnering with autonomous vehicle firm Pony.ai for the rollout.
Public trials will launch in the capital of Kazakhstan during the first half of twenty twenty seven.
Nvidia hardware and computing technology will power the autonomous driving infrastructure.
This expansion moves inDrive beyond standard ridesharing to compete directly with global autonomous services.
Would you trust an AI driver in your city?
